items.q: Erectile failure only with partner but normal nocturnal and morning erections most suggests what?
items.exp: Preserved nocturnal erections prove intact vascular neurogenic axis, pointing situational psychological causes (performance anxiety, relationship). Global loss including nocturnal suggests organic disease needing workup.
r: Incorrect. Vascular failure abolishes nocturnal erections too.
Correct. Situational with intact nocturnal means psychogenic.
Incorrect. Low testosterone reduces desire and nocturnal quality.
Incorrect. Cancer link is via treatment effects, not this pattern.
items.kp: Morning wood present, partner failure: mind, not vessels.

items.q: Absolute contraindication to PDE5 inhibitors (sildenafil class) is concurrent use of what?
items.exp: Combined nitric oxide cGMP amplification causes profound hypotension; nitrate use (including recreational nitrites) absolutely contraindicates PDE5 inhibitors, and alpha blocker co use needs caution and spacing.
r: Incorrect. Statins combine safely.
Correct. Nitrates plus PDE5 can collapse pressure.
Incorrect. SSRIs affect orgasm, not this lethal interaction.
Incorrect. Antihistamines safe.
items.kp: Sildenafil plus nitrate equals pressure crash.

items.q: New erectile dysfunction in a 58 year old smoker should prompt which assessment beyond sexual history?
items.exp: Penile arteries smaller than coronaries declare atherosclerosis earlier, so erectile dysfunction is sentinel event for cardiovascular risk stratification, lipids, pressure and glucose screening.
r: Incorrect. Misses sentinel value.
Correct. Screen heart and diabetes risk.
Incorrect. Surgery not indicated by symptom.
Incorrect. Testosterone only when deficient.
items.kp: Failed erections warn of future heart attacks.

items.q: Patient develops anorgasmia after starting an SSRI. Best initial approach is what?
o: Discuss options: watchful adaptation, dose timing or reduction, switching agent or adjuncts with prescriber
items.exp: SSRI sexual dysfunction is common and adherence killing; shared decisions include brief adaptation wait, lowest effective dose, switching to lower risk agents (mirtazapine, bupropion patterns) or adjuncts, balancing relapse risk, never abrupt cessation.
r: Incorrect. Abrupt stop causes discontinuation and relapse.
Correct. Shared adjustment or switch plan.
Incorrect. Antipsychotics worsen sexual function.
Incorrect. Dismissal breaks adherence and trust.
items.kp: Treat the side effect or lose the patient.

items.q: Gender dysphoria diagnosis centres on what, as opposed to gender nonconformity?
o: Clinically significant distress from incongruence between experienced and assigned gender
items.exp: Nonconformity and orientation are not disorders; dysphoria requires marked incongruence with distress or impairment (DSM six month pattern), guiding supportive multidisciplinary care.
r: Incorrect. Clothing alone is expression, not diagnosis.
Correct. Distress from incongruence defines dysphoria.
Incorrect. Orientation is separate axis.
Incorrect. Fertility counselling matters but not diagnosis.

items.q: Before gender affirming hormones, essential counselling includes which effect?
o: Fertility may be permanently reduced; offer preservation options
items.exp: Hormones can impair gamete production variably and sometimes permanently, so sperm or oocyte preservation discussion precedes treatment, alongside expected timelines and partial irreversibility of some changes.
r: Incorrect. Some effects persist after stopping.
Correct. Counsel and offer fertility preservation.
Incorrect. Changes are treatment purpose.
Incorrect. Support accompanies all stages.

items.q: A sexual interest pattern becomes paraphilic disorder when which condition applies?
o: It causes distress, impairment or involves non consenting harm
items.exp: DSM requires distress or impairment (for non harm types) or acting with non consenting persons or minors for disorder; consensual adult atypical interests without distress are variants, not illness.
r: Incorrect. Rarity alone is not pathology.
Correct. Distress, impairment or non consenting harm.
Incorrect. Moral disapproval is not criterion.
Incorrect. Age of onset does not define disorder.
items.kp: Consent and distress draw the disorder line.

items.q: Disclosure of sexual attraction to children with access to children triggers professional duty to what?
o: Act on safeguarding: assess risk, share information per child protection duties and law, involve specialist services
items.exp: Child safety overrides routine confidentiality within legal safeguarding frameworks; risk assessment, referral to specialised services and information sharing protect identifiable children, while treating non offending help seekers supportively encourages disclosure.
r: Incorrect. Safeguarding law limits confidentiality here.
Correct. Safeguard children and refer specially.
Incorrect. Reassurance without action endangers.
Incorrect. Prevention precedes offences.

items.q: Premature ejaculation first line management combines what approaches?
o: Behavioural techniques (stop start, squeeze), topical anaesthesia or on demand or daily SSRI by severity and preference
items.exp: Stepped care uses behavioural training, topical agents, and serotonergic delay (dapoxetine on demand where licensed or daily SSRI off label patterns) plus psychosexual therapy addressing anxiety and partner factors.
r: Incorrect. Daily drugs are one option tier.
Correct. Behavioural plus topical or SSRI options.
Incorrect. PDE5 helps comorbid erectile issue only.
Incorrect. No surgical standard exists.
items.kp: Train, numb or delay: stepped premature care.

items.q: Vaginismus and genito pelvic pain disorder management centres on what?
o: Pelvic floor physiotherapy, graded dilators, psychosexual therapy and treating vulval or pelvic pathology
items.exp: Pain and penetration disorders combine pelvic floor overactivity, fear avoidance and local pathology; graded desensitisation, physio and psychosexual care with gynaecology treat mechanisms, never forced penetration.
r: Incorrect. Force traumatises and worsens spasm.
Correct. Graded pelvic and psychosexual programme.
Incorrect. Surgery rare selected only.
Incorrect. Gentle consented assessment finds causes.
items.kp: Relax the floor gradually, never force.
